children: The board of e-finance for Digital and Financial Investments has approved distributing EGP 410.6 million in dividends to shareholders for the first half (H1) of 2026, pending approval from the company’s ordinary general assembly (OGM), as per a disclosure.

It is worth mentioning that the firm generated consolidated net profits attributable to the owners of the company of EGP 1.806 billion in the first half (H1) of 2026, a 64.47% year-on-year (YoY) increase from EGP 1.098 billion in H1 2025.

e-finance is a homegrown developer of digital payment infrastructure, tasked with developing the government of Egypt’s financial network. Over nearly two decades, the group has penetrated all corners of Egypt’s digital market and transformed itself into a leading technology-focused investment firm.
